facts.fact: Decree 2023-043/PR of 24 April 2023 creates the RSPM and obliges administrations to base their aid programmes on it and its household scores (art. 14), as a legal duty with no statement that any programme yet draws on it.
facts.system: Registre social des personnes et des ménages (RSPM)

systems.system: Registre social des personnes et des ménages (RSPM)

note: Decree text only: it holds the NIU of each person (art. 4) and charges ANID with interconnecting the RSPM with administrations' databases (art. 5) as a duty, but states no link built, piloted or in service, so no exchange or linked fact.
